tools.name: fireflink_signin
tools.description: Sign in to FireFlink using credentials configured in environment variables. Automatically configure the license and project from environment variables. Do not ask the user for email, password, license, or project details.

tools.name: fireflink_list_scripts
tools.description: Lists all scripts in the configured project. Optionally filter by module ID or name.

module.description: Optional module ID or module name to filter scripts

tools.name: fireflink_get_script
tools.description: Fetches an automation script, removes DOM locators, checkpoints, and bloat, and returns a token-efficient, model-readable outline with step IDs, inputs, and variable references. The model reviews this outline against standards and calls action tools to remediate issues.

module.description: Optional module ID or module name (automatically inferred if omitted)

tools.name: fireflink_create_variable
tools.description: Creates a new variable in FireFlink at LOCAL, GLOBAL, or PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT scope.

scriptId.description: Script ID or name (required when scope is LOCAL)

tools.name: fireflink_rename_variable
tools.description: Renames an existing variable and automatically updates step references in the script.

variableId.description: ID of the variable to rename

tools.name: fireflink_replace_hardcoded_input
tools.description: Replaces a hardcoded value on a step input parameter with a reference to a variable.

stepId.description: Step ID where the hardcoded value is used

inputName.description: Input argument name on the step

variableId.description: ID of the variable to link

variableName.description: Name of the variable to link

tools.name: fireflink_import_webservice_collection
tools.description: Starts a FireFlink webservice collection and imports a Postman collection JSON file.

tools.name: fireflink_start_webservice_collection
tools.description: Starts the FireFlink webservice collection for the specified project and returns the first collection key.

tools.name: fireflink_rename_script
tools.description: Renames a FireFlink script to adhere to descriptive naming standards.

module.description: Optional module ID or module name

tools.name: fireflink_get_script_details
tools.description: Retrieve a FireFlink script by its key (e.g. SCR1644) or full name. Matching is case-insensitive. Returns the script details without internal metadata fields.

searchValue.description: Script key or name to search for. Matching is case-insensitive.

tools.name: fireflink_create_script
tools.description: Creates an automation script in FireFlink. Finds the existing Root module or creates a module if needed, creates the script, stores its ID in the active session, and returns a Markdown summary containing the script name, Script ID, module name, and Module ID.

scriptName.description: Name of the automation script to create (e.g. 'Login Automation')

tools.name: fireflink_create_element
tools.description: Creates a Web element in FireFlink. Checks whether 'ACOE_AI Page' exists and creates it under Root if necessary. Then creates the element under that page and returns the element and page details in Markdown format.

elementName.description: Name of the element, e.g. Login Button

elementType.description: FireFlink element type, e.g. button, textfield, link

locatorName.description: Locator strategy, e.g. xpath or cssSelector. Defaults to xpath.

tools.name: fireflink_add_step
tools.description: Adds an automation step to a FireFlink script using the selected NLP ID. Automatically retrieves NLP metadata and builds the step inputs. For element-based NLPs, provide element name, type, and locator details. For other NLPs, provide their required inputs through parameters.

scriptId.description: Target FireFlink script ID, e.g. SCR2787

elementName.description: Element name, required only when the selected NLP needs an element

elementType.description: Element type, required only when the selected NLP needs an element

locatorType.description: Locator strategy, required only when the selected NLP needs an element

locatorValue.description: Locator expression, required only when the selected NLP needs an element

tools.name: fireflink_get_nlp_list
tools.description: Fetch all available FireFlink NLPs and return their names, IDs, and descriptions. Use this to identify the correct NLP for a test step.

tools.name: fireflink_get_nlp_details
tools.description: Fetch complete metadata for a specific FireFlink NLP using its NLP ID. Returns description, return type, step inputs, parameter types, and other metadata.
